enabled.description: `Always` call forwarding is enabled or disabled.

ringReminderEnabled.description: If `true`, a brief tone will be played on the person's phone when a call has been forwarded.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Sending incoming calls to voicemail is enabled/disabled when the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

always.description: Settings for forwarding all incoming calls to the destination you choose.

enabled.description: `Busy` call forwarding is enabled or disabled.

ringReminderEnabled.description: If `true`, a brief tone will be played on the person's phone when a call has been forwarded.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Sending incoming calls to voicemail is enabled/disabled when the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

selective.description: Selectively forward calls to a designated number, depending on criteria rules. You'll need to have at least one rule for forwarding applied for call forwarding to be active.

operatingModes.description: Configuration for forwarding via Operating modes (Schedule Based Routing).

enabled.description: Indicates whether operating modes forwarding is enabled.

callForwarding.description: Settings related to `Always`, `Busy`, and `No Answer` call forwarding.
